tasks.title: Create server-systemd.ts with install mode detection and service file generation
tasks.description: Create packages/cli/src/cli/commands/server-systemd.ts with: isSystemdServiceInstalled() checking ~/.config/systemd/user/mohist.service existence, detectInstallMode() resolving node path via process.execPath and script path via __dirname traversal (source: walk up to find packages/cli/bin/mo-server; npm global: resolve from __dirname), generateServiceFile() building the .service content with all required fields and CR/LF injection validation. Service file must include [Unit] Description/After, [Service] Type/ExecStart/Restart/RestartSec/TimeoutStopSec/SuccessExitStatus/StandardError/WorkingDirectory(source-only), [Install] WantedBy.
acceptanceCriteria: detectInstallMode() returns correct { nodePath, scriptPath, workingDir? } for source mode (when packages/cli/bin/mo-server exists relative to __dirname)
detectInstallMode() returns correct paths for npm global mode (no packages/cli found)
generateServiceFile() produces valid .service content with [Unit], [Service], [Install] sections
generateServiceFile() includes WorkingDirectory only in source mode
generateServiceFile() rejects values containing \\n or \\r characters (CR/LF injection prevention)
isSystemdServiceInstalled() returns true when ~/.config/systemd/user/mohist.service exists
isSystemdServiceInstalled() returns false when service file does not exist
process.execPath is used for node binary path (handles nvm/fnm/volta)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the foundation module. All other tasks import from it.

tasks.title: Implement systemctl helper with headless SSH fallback and linger management
tasks.description: Add to server-systemd.ts: a runSystemctlUser() helper that wraps execSync for systemctl --user commands, catches D-Bus/session errors, and retries with systemctl --machine <username>@ --user for headless SSH. Add runLinger() that executes loginctl enable-linger <username> (tolerates already-enabled). Add getSystemdStatus() that runs systemctl show mohist.service to extract ActiveState and MainPID. These are pure utility functions used by install/uninstall/status delegation.
acceptanceCriteria: runSystemctlUser('start mohist.service') executes systemctl --user start mohist.service
When systemctl --user fails with D-Bus/session error, retries with systemctl --machine <username>@ --user
runLinger() executes loginctl enable-linger without error when already enabled
getSystemdStatus() returns { activeState, mainPID } parsed from systemctl show output
getSystemdStatus() returns null when service is not loaded
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Appends to server-systemd.ts created in T-001. All functions are exported for use by server.ts.

tasks.title: Implement install and uninstall systemd service commands
tasks.description: Add installSystemdService() and uninstallSystemdService() to server-systemd.ts. installSystemdService(): detect mode, generate service file, ensure ~/.config/systemd/user/ directory exists, write .service file, run daemon-reload + enable + start via runSystemctlUser, run linger. Handle re-install (service already exists) by overwriting and restarting instead of just starting. uninstallSystemdService(): if service file missing, print 'Service not installed' and exit 0; otherwise run disable --now, delete file, daemon-reload.
acceptanceCriteria: installSystemdService() writes service file to ~/.config/systemd/user/mohist.service
installSystemdService() runs daemon-reload, enable, start, and enable-linger in sequence
installSystemdService() overwrites and restarts when service file already exists
installSystemdService() displays success message with service name
uninstallSystemdService() runs systemctl --user disable --now mohist.service
uninstallSystemdService() deletes the .service file and runs daemon-reload
uninstallSystemdService() displays 'Service not installed' and exits 0 when no service file
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Appends to server-systemd.ts. Uses runSystemctlUser and runLinger from T-002.

tasks.title: Add systemctl delegation to start/stop/status in server.ts
tasks.description: Modify packages/cli/src/cli/commands/server.ts: in startServer(), add early return path when isSystemdServiceInstalled() is true — run systemctl --user start, wait for health check, print 'Server started (systemd)'. In stopServer(), add early return when systemd installed — run systemctl --user stop, print 'Server stopped (systemd)'. In serverStatus(), when systemd installed, use getSystemdStatus() to show active/inactive/failed state with PID and uptime from systemctl, then return. When systemd not installed, all three functions fall through to existing spawn/pidfile logic unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: startServer() delegates to systemctl --user start when systemd service is installed
startServer() falls through to existing spawn logic when systemd service is not installed
stopServer() delegates to systemctl --user stop when systemd service is installed
stopServer() falls through to existing PID file logic when systemd service is not installed
serverStatus() shows systemd state (active/inactive/failed) with PID from systemctl show when installed
serverStatus() falls through to existing PID file logic when systemd service is not installed
Existing spawn-based start/stop/status behavior is preserved when no systemd service
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Imports isSystemdServiceInstalled, getSystemdStatus, runSystemctlUser from server-systemd.ts.

tasks.title: Add SIGTERM exit code 143 handling to server process
tasks.description: Modify packages/cli/src/server/index.ts SIGTERM handler: after calling agentRunner.shutdown() and server.stop(), call process.exit(143) (128 + 15) to signal clean SIGTERM exit. This ensures systemd recognizes exit code 143 as success via the SuccessExitStatus=0 143 directive in the .service file.
acceptanceCriteria: SIGTERM handler calls process.exit(143) after graceful shutdown
SIGINT handler remains unchanged (existing behavior)
Server process exits with code 143 on SIGTERM
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Independent of T-001 through T-004. Small surgical change to existing SIGTERM handler.

tasks.title: Implement restart and update commands
tasks.description: Add restartServer() and updateServer() functions. restartServer(): if systemd installed, run systemctl --user restart and print 'Server restarted (systemd)'; otherwise call stopServer() then startServer() (reuse existing exports). updateServer(): validate source mode (reject npm global with message), validate systemd service installed (reject with message), run npm run build in packages/cli/ (abort on failure), run npm run build in packages/cli/web/ (abort on failure), run systemctl --user restart, print each step result.
acceptanceCriteria: restartServer() delegates to systemctl --user restart when systemd installed
restartServer() calls stop then start when systemd not installed
updateServer() rejects with message when in npm global mode
updateServer() rejects with message when no systemd service installed
updateServer() runs npm run build in packages/cli/ and packages/cli/web/
updateServer() aborts without restart on build failure
updateServer() runs systemctl --user restart after successful builds
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: restartServer can go in server-systemd.ts or server.ts. updateServer needs detectInstallMode and runSystemctlUser.

mo server uninstall command is registered and calls uninstallSystemdService
mo server restart command is registered and calls restartServer

mo server --help output includes install, uninstall, restart, update subcommands
